name: orbit
description: Orbit — a full-lifecycle skill pack for Claude Code: Understand → Build → Operate. 89 skills, each with a clear method: when to use it, inputs, procedure, output, checks and pitfalls. One pipeline with shared `.orbit/` artifacts, methods from 18 community packs and the ASD-STE100 standard rewritten with references and licences in every skill. Reverse engineering, spec-driven development on OpenSpec with a live project map, DevOps (Kubernetes/Helm/GitOps, CI, incidents), plain-language answers. Native Claude Code plugin; skills are portable to Codex, Qwen Code, GLM, DeepSeek and any SKILL.md loader.
